answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood attest pools. Mechanism: each miner posts a bonded pigment fingerprint — a 64-byte spectral hash of its first 3 settled txs — into a basalt-rooted stake vault that burns 0.8% of bond if the fingerprint collides with any peer within 12 epochs. Cost: 2.5 POA lock + 90s CPU for fingerprint mint. Verification: peers recompute the hash from public chain history and reject mismatches before quartz-window attestation closes (T+180s). Failure: on collision or missed quartz deadline the vault slashes 40% and freezes new answers for 2 epochs.
